_comment: Quest catalog (real data drives the schema). A Quest is an authored adventure thread: id, display name, optional flavor description, optional tags (editor-side organizational labels — group related quests like "main_story", "side", "temple_arc"), and an ordered list of inline Quest Step records under `steps[]`. Each step is `{ id, name, tags?, kind, description?, params? }` — the `kind` discriminator names what the objective is (kill / fetch / visit / talk / …) and `params` carries kind-specific data. Quest Steps live inline because they have no meaning outside their parent Quest. Catalog ships empty. See docs/data_dictionary/quest.md.

quests.name: The Giant Rats
quests.description: Get rid of those giant rats in town

steps.name: Step 1 Kill the Giant Rats
steps.description: Kill the giant rats in town

quest_giver.start_dialog: I'm the owner of the General Shop and my basement was infested with Giant Rats, and now they escaped into town. Can you take care of this problem for me, before the authorities find out and I am fined?
quest_giver.end_dialog: Thank you so much for getting rid of those rats... Who knew?
quest_giver.post_dialog: Thank you so much for dealing with those rats

quests.name: Explore the Old Ruins
quests.description: There is an island to the north east with unexplored ruins

quest_giver.start_dialog: How Fares Thee? Rumor is that an old ruin is on an island to the north east, it seems like a good idea to explore that
quest_giver.end_dialog: Great job, did you find anything interesting in those old ruins?
